notes: Province-granular files: Wages_byProvince (30 series = 29 provinces + national avg, P1Y IDR BPS) and GRDP_byProvince (30 series, quarterly P3M IDR mn by province, BPS). Both kept; subcategory = province name. | InterestFXRates_Monthly is mixed (30 series): 19 remain id_interest_rates; 10 FX/REER/NEER series overridden to id_exchange_rate_operations; 1 10Y govt bond yield series overridden to id_capital_markets. | GovtExpenditure is mixed (30 series): 5 GDP SNA govt-consumption component series overridden to id_gdp_by_expenditure; 25 Ministry of Finance ytd expenditure flows remain id_government_accounts. | ManufacturingPMI: 2 headline PMI (S&P Global, unit=NA) + 10 Now-Casting Impact series (unit=Basis Point). Nowcast impact series are borderline id_cyclical_activity_indices but kept under id_business_surveys per file guide. | MutualFund_NAV_AUM: single series is Mutual Fund holdings of Govt Securities (daily P1D, IDR bn, DJPPR) -- assigned id_capital_markets. | CurrentAccount: 7 quarterly IMF BoP series + 1 annual World Bank remittances series (P1Y USD mn) -- frequency mismatch; all assigned id_balance_of_payments. | WholesalePriceIndex: main series 2023=100 base; 3 legacy manufacturing sub-items still on 2018=100 -- mixed base years in one file. | GovBondYieldCurve: daily P1D yield curve 12Y-28Y from PHEI (long end only, no short tenors in this file). | ImportsByCommodity: single series only -- Commodities and Other Special Transactions (P1M USD mn, BPS). Very sparse coverage for a 'by commodity' file.
